description_en: Submits a CosyVoice voice cloning training task
description_zh: 提交CosyVoice版本人声克隆训练任务
kebab_example: aliyun ice submit-cosy-voice-customized-voice-job --voice-name '小专' --gender female --audios 0000571c704445f9a0ee011406c20000 --demo-audio-media-url https://your-bucket.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/demo.MP3 --model cosyvoice-v3-plus --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitCosyVoiceCustomizedVoiceJob

parameters.help_en: The voice name. The name can be up to 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 声音名字，不超过 32 个字符
parameters.name: voice_name

parameters.help_en:
The gender. Valid values:
female
male
parameters.help_zh:
性别，取值范围：
female：女性
male：男性
parameters.name: gender

parameters.help_en: The media asset ID of the training audio material. Currently, only one audio material is supported for training
parameters.help_zh: 训练声音素材媒资 Id，当前仅支持对一个音频素材进行训练
parameters.name: audios

parameters.help_en:
The sample audio output address.  
If you specify this parameter, a sample audio file is generated at the specified OSS address after training succeeds.  
<notice>The address must be a valid public OSS address under your account.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
示例音频输出地址  
如果传入此参数，则会在训练成功后在此参数表示的 OSS 地址生成示例音频  
<notice>需要是您账号下合法的 OSS 公网地址></notice>
parameters.name: demo_audio_media_url

parameters.help_en:
The voice cloning model. Valid values:
cosyvoice-v3-plus
cosyvoice-v3-flash
cosyvoice-v3.5-plus
cosyvoice-v3.5-flash
parameters.help_zh:
声音克隆模型。包含：
cosyvoice-v3-plus
cosyvoice-v3-flash
cosyvoice-v3.5-plus
cosyvoice-v3.5-flash
parameters.name: model

JobId.description_en: The ID of the voice cloning task

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，取值：
true：成功
false：失败
